name: Cloud and SaaS Forensics Pack
description: Method and tooling for logs that belong to somebody else's computer, examined as supplied exports: what a cloud or SaaS export covers and what its silence can show, the Microsoft 365 unified audit log, Entra sign-ins, AWS CloudTrail, Google Workspace, and the tokens, grants and mailbox rules behind a cloud account.

unreferenced_ok.name: pwsh
unreferenced_ok.why: an operator's acquisition runtime for Microsoft 365 collection; no skill or tool of this pack runs it, and the agent examines supplied exports offline and never connects to a tenant

unreferenced_ok.name: aws
unreferenced_ok.why: an operator's acquisition capability for CloudTrail, Config and GuardDuty records; no skill or tool of this pack runs it (`aws/cloudtrail` only reads supplied exports, and its id spells the program), and an agent never connects to an account with it

method_only.why: the pack's router: it names the other notes by the question each answers and holds no rule, tool or program of its own
a method leaf for Workspace evidence: the pack has no reader for token, Drive or admin events, so it reads the export as supplied and names no tool or program
a method leaf about what a supplied export covers and what its silence can say; it applies to every provider and sends the agent to the provider's own skill for any tool
